title: Elf Bar Plus50 Blueberry Sour Raspberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blueberry Sour Raspberry from the Elf Bar Plus50 pod range blends sweet, mellow Blueberry with a sharp burst of Sour Raspberry for a bold, balanced vape. The bright tanginess of the Raspberry lifts the softer notes of Blueberry, making this one of the most popular flavour profiles in the collection. Each Plus50 pod contains 2ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid and can join two other pods in the Elf Bar Plus50 Pod Kit, with no mess or fuss. The integrated mesh coil delivers consistently smooth performance with discreet vapour, ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Each pod is topped up via a prefilled 10ml refill pod, and together each pod and refill can deliver up to 5,500 puffs of flavour.
